set: A: the three keys, the sheet `machines` and the page at rest, whole, and native crops of each

issues.where: the three select fields, right column (also set-A-05, set-A-06 'a field', set-A-09 'a field')
issues.what: the field wells are a flat, evenly graded grey-blue panel; nothing shows through, no glass depth, no reflection or highlight band, no texture. At native size they read as a CSS inset box with an inner shadow, not glass or a sunk slab
issues.fix: give the well floor real material: a faint reflection or highlight band across the top third, slight tint variation, a visible thickness at the edge with a bright chamfer line, and either something under the glass or a matte milled floor with grain

issues.where: the tray floor behind the crank and meter (also set-A-02 behind the dial, set-A-07 'the tray the machine sits in', set-A-08)
issues.what: the tray floor is one smooth, even grey-green fill. The lit meter segments throw almost no light onto it (only a thin orange line at the tray's bottom lip), so the glow looks pasted on and does not light the surface it sits on
issues.fix: add a warm pool of spill light on the tray floor and the inner walls under and beside the lit segments, falling off with distance, and give the floor a slight grain or brushed finish

issues.where: the crank on the parts sheet, right; the slot machine lever; the dial base
issues.what: the parts stand on the page and are not set into it. Each has one soft, offset drop blur, with no dark contact line where the plate meets the paper and no socket or recess. The crank plate in particular looks like a flat disc laid on top
issues.fix: add a tight dark contact shadow at each base edge beneath the soft one, and seat the plates in a shallow milled recess or on a visible bezel, with a gap line all round

issues.what: the dial has no small hardware: no centre screw or retaining clip and no screws on the base ring. The finger wheel and the base are not clearly two parts with a gap between them, so it reads a little toy-like when zoomed
issues.fix: add a fine dark gap between the finger wheel and the base ring, plus two or three tiny screws, and a faint engraved index mark

issues.what: the reel digits are flat print with no curvature distortion as they wrap the drum, and the red payline sits over the digits like a drawn line rather than a wire or a mark on the glass
issues.fix: compress the digits slightly toward the top and bottom of each drum, and give the payline a tiny shadow or reflection so it sits on the front glass

issues.where: the arrow over the dial's finger stop, and the arrow over the crank grip in set-A-03
issues.what: the arrow's shadow lands at the same soft offset whether it sits over the deep tray or the raised dial, so it does not separate according to height
issues.fix: scale the arrow's shadow offset and blur by the height of the surface under it: tighter over the raised dial and grip, wider over the tray floor

issues.where: the lower half of the page, below the Audio volume field
issues.what: a large stretch of bare page with only the paper texture, so the eye reads the surface as perfectly even
issues.fix: add a faint large-scale light falloff or vignette across the page so the empty area has some tonal variation
